title: From Early Dawning Light
description: From Early Dawning Light in Tonic Solfa to SOUTHWELL, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 618 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Trusting in God”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to SOUTHWELL; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: From ear-ly daw-ning light Till eve-ning shades a-rise, For thy sal-va-tion, Lord, I wait, With ev-er long-ing eyes.

lines: For thy salvation, Lord, I wait,
And lead me in thy truth;
Forgive the sins of riper days,
The Lord is just and kind;
The meek shall learn his ways,

licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to SOUTHWELL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
